blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Residents of Sarrat, Ilocos Norte, and nearby towns can now access laboratory tests, X-rays, and ultrasound services locally following the expansion of the town’s primary care facility. In a statement on Saturday, Sept. 19, the Department of Health (DOH) Ilocos Region said the new Clinical Laboratory, X-Ray and Ultrasound Services at the Sarrat Primary Care Facility (PCF) were inaugurated on Sept. 11 by the agency, along with the Ilocos Norte provincial government and the Sarrat municipal government. The P4.995-million upgrade was funded through the DOH Health Facilities Enhancement Program under the 2025 General Appropriations Act. READ: […]...
